title: Laxmi Engineering Works v. P.S.G. Industrial Institute

content.caseIdentity: Laxmi Engineering Works v. P.S.G. Industrial Institute, (1995) 3 SCC 583 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: Defined the scope of "commercial purpose" and the "self-employment exception". Held that a person purchasing machinery to operate it personally for earning a livelihood is a consumer, whereas commercial activity undertaken for large-scale profit generation is excluded.
content.relevance: The foundational Supreme Court precedent interpreting the definition of consumer under Section 2(7).
